ينبطح (form VII)
# يَنْبَطِحُ (yanbaṭiḥu) /jan.ba.tˤi.ħu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# يَنْبَطِحَ (yanbaṭiḥa) /jan.ba.tˤi.ħa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# يَنْبَطِحْ (yanbaṭiḥ) /jan.ba.tˤiħ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
